cartes.a: Habits, truths, timetables. Signals: always, usually, every day. She plays / doesn't play / Does she play?
Finished, dated action. Signals: yesterday, last week, ago. I visited / didn't visit / Did you visit?
WILL = prediction, instant decision, promise. GOING TO = plan, evidence. I will help / am going to study.
Past action linked to present; experience; since/for. Signals: just, already, ever, never. I have finished / haven't / Have you?
The 'past of the past': first action = had + V3, second = past simple. I had finished before he arrived.
Happening NOW, temporary. Signals: now, Look! I am studying / am not / Are you studying?
In progress at a past moment; long action cut by short one. I was sleeping when he arrived.
Dated past marker (yesterday, in 2020, ago) → past simple. No date + link to present (just, already) → present-perfect.
Did + base verb (Did she go?), he/she/it + s (She plays).
Past continuous (long) + when + past simple (short). While + continuous, continuous.
Prediction with a visible clue → GOING TO. No clue/promise → WILL.
cartes.q: 'Look at those clouds!' → will or going to?

cartes.a: Present-perfect (experience, ever, no date). Never say: have visited yesterday.
cartes.q: 'Have you ever been to London?' — why perfect?
